lines.text: Sign it, or I end you tonight!
A guard grabs MIRA's wrist and forces the pen into her hand.
Let her go. The board is watching this feed live.
Every screen on the floor flickers on. Board members stare out from video calls.
Serena. Step away from her. Now.
Declan, you swore you were with me.
The clock begins to chime midnight.
MIRA lifts the pen, looks straight at the camera, and smiles.
Midnight. So who works for who now?
SERENA smiles back and draws a second envelope from her jacket.
